Why Pillar

Local first

No database, no service, no account. A site is a directory and saving is writing a file.

Schema driven

One block in a template becomes the whole editing surface — nothing else can be changed.

Git is the store

Draft is the working tree, publish is a commit, history is git log, rollback is git revert.
